sources.citation: Briggs & Stratton 12 kW standby Installation/Operator manual 80079504 Rev B https://images.thdstatic.com/catalog/pdfImages/a7/a7c84f48-fcdf-4914-8777-a9c071f50096.pdf ; "Operation Instructions GC1031 GENSET Controller" 80086364 https://gatewayelectricmotors.com/websites/gatewayelectricmotors.com/ecommerce/products/9/files/Operators-Manual-040587-00.pdf (checked: 2026-09-01)

transport: 2-wire maintained dry contact · open-circuit voltage: ? · current: ? · field terminal block pins 4 and 5 "2 Wire-Start", "Contact Close for Genset Start", 18 AWG twisted pair 300 V 90 °C (80079504 p.21); input is "active low" (GC1031 §4.1.2 p.15) so one side is battery negative

models.name: 040627-class 12 kW
models.notes: pins 6/7 are E-Stop, "Contact Open to Shutdown"

gotchas: "Mains monitoring must be disabled in the controller" (p.21) — otherwise the utility-sense logic overrides the contact.

GC1031 §4.1.2: start/stop by "activating/deactivating the preconfigured Remote Start/Stop input (active low) in a continuous state"; deactivating stops "with a pre-defined sequence" (cool-down length not stated).
No voltage or current figure in either document.
